task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to make sure that the door inside the dish-pit is wide open. And then, attempt to head north. And then, doublecheck that the gateway is open. Then, attempt to venture west. Once you accomplish that, try to go to the north. Then, venture west. And then, recover the latchkey from the pan. That's it!
